shared: All three are a weather court whose units Gust: extra attacks out of turn that leave permanent stats.
differ: They split on where power goes: a last-played carry, a second wave from hand, or the biggest unit.

takes.label: Crown your last play
takes.line: Whichever unit you play last, any tribe, takes permanent stats from a stack of Court cards and grows into one huge carry.
takes.look_if: to choose your carry by play order, then pump it every turn.

takes.label: The army in hand
takes.line: Units kept in hand sit out the opening and land mid-fight, so your hand fights as a second board.
takes.look_if: fights that turn halfway as reinforcements land and the dead return.

takes.label: Bow to the favourite
takes.line: Courtiers give up their own attacks so your biggest unit strikes in their place, turning the whole board into one unit's queue.
takes.look_if: one huge unit taking every attack while the rest stand back.
